customManagers.description: Container images referenced by any component-constructor

Helm charts published as OCI artifacts. The ocm-components manager only covers access.type 'helm' (helmChart + helmRepository); charts pushed to ghcr use access.type 'ociArtifact' with an imageReference and would otherwise never be bumped.
The pinned OCM v2 CLI. dev-kit's tools.lock manager cannot track this — it installs the legacy v1 CLI, so the version lives in the Makefile instead.

packageRules.description: The image repositories publish both 0.5.0 and v0.5.0 for the same release; the chart repository only publishes unprefixed tags. Without this, Renovate picks the v-prefixed image tags and a component ends up mixing both formats. Constrain every constructor dependency to the unprefixed scheme — the common denominator.

Never pin digests inside a component-constructor. The shared preset sets pinDigests globally, but a digest suffix turns 'repo:tag' into 'repo:tag@sha256:...', which breaks the jsonata $split on ':' above. OCM resolves and records digests at build time anyway.

A wrapped image or chart bump IS the component's new version — the component version is derived from the chart resource, so a Renovate bump is what produces a release. Typed as `fix` to keep the history conventional.

Renovate's docker datasource builds its release list from the registry tag list, which carries no dates, so no release here ever gets a releaseTimestamp and minimumReleaseAge can never be satisfied — the update stays pending forever. Measured: with the window applied, both images sit at "pendingChecks": true while the exempted chart does not. The window buys nothing anyway — these artifacts come from our own org, and nothing is published until the bump is reviewed and merged.

One PR per component. A component's version is derived from its chart, so its chart and both images have to move together — but two different components must never share a PR, or one merge publishes two releases. groupSlug has to be set alongside groupName: the shared preset pins it to all-minor-updates, and groupName alone does not override it — measured, the branch then comes out named after the literal, un-expanded template.
